plan: Keep queueing jungle as primary — it is already Willy's usual queue AND best role at 51.0% over 173 games (overall is 50.4%).
Comfort-hero rule for the climb: Zinx. Compared with the average player on the same hero, Willy wins about 3.8 more games per 100 on it.
Willy's champion pool is 12+ heroes wide and the top three are only 45% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
The math: Willy is at 402 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 903 — Platinum-level rating has been touched once already; this is a consistency problem, not a ceiling problem.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why

insights.title: Willy is a closer, not a marathoner
insights.finding: Games under 28 minutes: 54%. Past 32: 33%. Press early leads and call objectives; do not let games drift.
insights.receipt: wins 7 of 13 short games vs 4 of 12 long ones, recent sample

insights.title: Gadget is the long-term relationship
insights.finding: 227 games on Gadget at 50.2% — the field averages 49.7%. The comfort is real; the edge is roughly neutral.

insights.title: Cuban brings out Willy's best
insights.finding: Willy's record alongside Cuban Noobster is 54% over 442 ranked games — the strongest pairing in the stack. When only two of the squad queue, make it this pair.

insights.title: For the group chat
